title: SendReceipt
description: Record that a send adapter transmitted exactly the permitted draft. A receipt exists only if a transmission happened: when no adapter is configured nothing is sent and no SendReceipt is produced (a denied send is SendPermission send_authorized=false followed by OutcomeRecord SEND_NOT_AUTHORIZED). In S1 no mail adapter exists; every receipt in this repository is a SYNTHETIC_FIXTURE and proves no production transmission.
